content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble creating a program to control three water pumps. I want to use three float switches to alternate the pumps and balance their operating hours. I've seen many forum examples, but most only cover two alternating outputs. float switch 3 = high = starts the third pump float switch 2 = medium = starts the second pump, alternates between two pumps float switch 1 = low = Q1 or Q2 or Q3 (alternates) Float switch 1 is always activated first. I appreciate any help from the community. Thanks for your support
